remoteproc.uses_elf64_semantics: uses_elf64 configures ELFCLASS64 coredumps. Actual paired stock modem/DTB/IPA files are now structurally verified ELF32 little-endian; see hardware/sm8650-modem-stock.json.
remoteproc.rmb: The captured modem has one MMIO resource. qcom_q6v5_init requests optional resource index 1 for RMB, so this DT supplies no RMB base. Do not interpret offsets 8/12/16 as modem_base-relative MMIO.

glink.partition_note: Item IDs are host-partition scoped; ADSP host 2 buffers cannot be reused for modem host 1.

uefi_pil.status: Actual stock modem entry/load minimum 0x8bc00000 and end0x99e00000 match the captured DT layout. Do not apply the old 0x8a200000 OverrideElfAddr config to that DSM layout. Configuration existence is not boot evidence.

ipa.event_ring_note: The second tuple value is a GSI channel ID, not an event-ring ID. Rings and their DMA addresses are allocated/configured at runtime and remain unvalidated.
ipa.runtime_note: Endpoint and GSI entries are static driver configuration; availability, DMA ownership, firmware compatibility and traffic have not been tested.

memory_reservation_overlay.scope: Explicit source reservations before dynamic RAM mapping; not SCM permission or live ownership evidence.

qualification_notes: All DT properties are captured Android configuration, not established XNU ownership or runtime readiness.
The pinned modem node has no power-domains property: cx/mx RPMh ARC regulators, XO clock, AOP QMP and interconnect votes are its explicit dependencies.
DT memory-region index 2 is dynamically allocated linux,cma, not a fixed modem firmware region.

The original PIL_Reserved alone omits DSM/QLINK. The current qualified MemoryMapLib overlay adds exactly those three reserved descriptors, and production preparation checks drift, copy and DSC/INF/FDF wiring.
modem reg-names cx/mx are consumed by adsp_init_regulator as supply names; the single reg tuple is the sole MMIO resource.
uses_elf64 describes coredump format. Do not infer firmware MDT ELF class from it.
Stock UEFI FULL_MODEM reserves 0x8a200000..0x9b000000, while the running Android DT MPSS span begins at 0x8bc00000. See docs/MODEM_BOOT_MAP.md.
IPA DT version 0x18 resolves to IPA_HW_v5_5=24; platform-type 1 resolves to MSM, selecting the IPA_5_5 production table and GSI_VER_5_5.

All 31 production IPA 5.5 endpoint/GSI routes and 10 test aliases are recorded. The test aliases overlap production hardware and are not separate deployable endpoints. Runtime event rings, routing/filtering rules, mux IDs and DMA ownership are not established.

Matching factory ROM firmware is available in private local cache: 55 files, all nonempty load segments sized/hashed, BSS identified, MDT header-plus-hash metadata verified, and IPA split payloads match GSI ELF. Hardware startup and secure authentication are not claimed.

The baseline RamManager can fill uncovered RAM-partition gaps. The current overlay supplies explicit DSM/QLINK reservations before that stage; final firmware map/SCM ownership remains a distinct handoff requirement.

local_evidence.kind: locally extracted stock UEFI PIL configuration strings; configuration evidence only
